implementation_phases.description: Implement foundational features that have no dependencies and can be executed in parallel

tasks.title: Add task retrieval functionality
tasks.rationale: Critical for downstream filtering and querying features

tasks.title: Enhance error handling with retry logic
tasks.rationale: Foundation for reliability features, blocks rate limiting

tasks.title: Add input validation for task creation

implementation_phases.completion_criteria: All foundation features implemented and tested

implementation_phases.description: Add filtering capabilities that depend on task retrieval functionality

tasks.title: Add database schema validation
tasks.rationale: Validates Notion database structure for reliability

implementation_phases.completion_criteria: All filtering and validation features operational

implementation_phases.description: Implement rate limit handling building on retry logic
implementation_phases.completion_criteria: Rate limiting properly handled with backoff

implementation_phases.description: Implement batch operations requiring both retrieval and retry capabilities

tasks.title: Add batch task operations
tasks.rationale: Requires both TASK-001 and TASK-005 for robust batch handling

implementation_phases.completion_criteria: Batch operations functional with error handling

implementation_phases.description: Complete comprehensive documentation after all features implemented

tasks.title: Enhance documentation with usage examples
tasks.rationale: Requires all major features complete to document properly

notes.parallelization: Phase 1 tasks can all run concurrently. Phase 2 tasks can run concurrently after Phase 1 completion.
notes.priority_focus: High-priority tasks: TASK-001, TASK-005, TASK-008, TASK-011 should be completed first
notes.optional_tasks: TASK-004 and TASK-010 are lower priority and can be deferred if resources are limited
